records.explanation: Variant B converts at 44.4% against 39.7% for A, a gap of 4.8 points. That is larger than the 1.26-point margin of error at 95% confidence, so the difference is statistically significant.
records.sql: with t as (select d.variant, sum(d.taps) as n, sum(d.installs)::numeric / sum(d.taps) as p from reporting.experiment_daily d join reporting.experiments e using (experiment_id) where e.experiment_name = 'Product page: new screenshots' group by d.variant), a as (select n as n_a, p as p_a from t where variant = 'A'), b as (select n as n_b, p as p_b from t where variant = 'B') select case when abs(p_b - p_a) > 1.96 * sqrt(p_a*(1-p_a)/n_a + p_b*(1-p_b)/n_b) then 'yes' else 'no' end as significant_at_95, p_a, p_b, p_b - p_a as diff, 1.96 * sqrt(p_a*(1-p_a)/n_a + p_b*(1-p_b)/n_b) as margin from a, b
